500 Internal Server Error when listing models due to server failure

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm import LiterLlmError, ServerError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        await client.list_models()
    except ServerError as error:
        print(f"ServerError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
